
{{alias}}( x, index, value )
    Return a new ndarray with the element at the specified index replaced with
    a provided value.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: ndarray
        Input ndarray.

    index: ArrayLikeObject
        Input array.

    value: any
        Replacement value.

    Returns
    -------
    out: ndarray
        Output ndarray.

    Examples
    --------
    > var x = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/array}}( [ [ 1.0, 2.0 ], [ 3.0, 4.0 ] ] );
    > var y = {{alias}}( x, [ 0, 0 ], 0.0 );
    > {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/to-array}}( y )
    [ [ 0.0, 2.0 ], [ 3.0, 4.0 ] ]

    See Also
    --------
